task.name: pick_marker_draw_cross_ep2
task.description: Use the right arm to grasp the marker in the green cup and draw a black cross mark on the table and then put it into the green cup.

substages.substage: 1. Move the right arm to approach and align with the marker in the green cup.
3. Move the right arm to align with the table.
4. Draw a black cross mark on the table.
5. Move the right arm to align with the green cup.
6. Release the gripper to put the marker into the green cup.
